records.outdated_source_warning: Do not import the simplified exam table as a diagnostic rule or home-treatment plan. The new case deliberately lacks the exclusions needed to establish SIADH. No salt/fluid dose is an answer requirement.

requirement_support.basis: pp7–10: assess hypotonicity and cause; urine results are not a stand-alone diagnosis.
p10 Table1: diuretics and adrenal causes can coexist with urinary sodium above30; author applies the confounder.
Medication review and acute symptom triage; same-day timing is an author safety hypothesis for this synthetic packet.
Emergency section: hyponatremia with acute confusion/delirium requires emergency assessment.
pp14–15: neurological status and course matter; author inference rejects numerical reassurance.
pp11,16–20: correction and monitoring are clinician-led; no home regimen imported.
p14: consider other acute diagnoses during emergency assessment.
